title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
why_read: A concrete, practical benchmark testing whether AI coding agents can actually port real ML codebases between PyTorch/GPU and JAX/TPU ecosystems.
analysis: This paper introduces a benchmark where agents must convert a working PyTorch repository into a functioning JAX repository, running on a different type of hardware than it was built for. The grading criteria are tied to the original paper's published results, offering an objective, verifiable pass/fail test. Reported pass rates, with the best agent reaching only 75%, show that even strong coding agents struggle with full-repository, cross-framework migration. This is useful and concrete evidence about current AI coding agent capabilities on a real, high-value software engineering task.
